finite_soundness.note: Finite tests supplement analytic soundness; oracle not claimed complete.

limitations: Exploratory reanalysis of same overlapping APEX tasks; not held-out or independent physical measurements.
Square relaxation and transformed latency objective unchanged from P17.
Exact disclosed-row savings; no measured money, network bytes, radio energy or operational cost.
Single sequential CPU pass is diagnostic only; not a controlled performance comparison.
Negative oracle is sufficient, not complete or claimed optimal.
Positive paths and positive competitive guarantee are unchanged.
A proper baseline should itself include sound negative stopping.
